measures.note: Descendants of people who taught two or more students, so the count reflects an art that spread through them rather than merely past them.
measures.title: Widest reach (excluding pass-through figures)

measures.note: Direct students who are themselves notable: they taught three or more people, founded or headed a style, or hold a recorded honour.
measures.title: Most prominent students

measures.note: Direct teacher-to-student links recorded in the dataset.
measures.title: Most students taught personally

measures.note: How many teachers this person studied under.
measures.title: Most teachers

measures.note: How many distinct styles are represented among this person's teachers.
measures.title: Most diverse teachers

measures.note: Distinct styles appearing anywhere among their descendants.
measures.title: Broadest stylistic spread

measures.note: How many generations the line runs below them.
measures.title: Deepest lineage

measures.note: Every descendant, however distant. Shown for completeness: an early figure inherits everyone who came after, so this ranks position in time as much as influence.
measures.title: Total descendants (rewards antiquity)

terminal.note: People with no recorded students, so the recorded line stops with them. Restricted to those born before 1950, since a living teacher's students may simply not be recorded yet.
